writerControls: every set and clear carries expectedVersion; a mismatch fails with NEX_ATTENTION_VERSION_CONFLICT instead of overwriting
a repeated requestId carrying the same decision replays as a no-op; the same requestId carrying a different decision, or a different actor reusing it, fails with NEX_ATTENTION_REQUEST_CONFLICT
actorId is NOT NULL: an unattributed disposition cannot be stored
clear is never an unconditional DELETE
negativeFixture: Attention rows are never mutated by Run publish, Finding Observation writes, or epoch rotation; only the typed Attention writer sets or clears them
